h1: Our Success Stories: 150+ Websites Built and Ranked
lead: These success stories show how Openink Hub has built 150+ websites on WordPress, Node.js and Next.js. They range from client business sites to 136 WordPress websites, each mapped to its own target keyword. We plan each site around a target keyword, build it for speed, and connect it to the tools that help it rank.

stack.h2: The technology behind our success stories

cards.title: Coding languages
items: JavaScript and TypeScript for Node.js and Next.js builds
PHP for WordPress themes, plugins and custom functions
HTML5 and CSS3 for clean, accessible page markup
SQL for MySQL queries, reports and data clean-up

cards.title: Frameworks and CMS
items: WordPress for blogs and sites the client edits each day
Next.js (React) for fast, server-rendered pages that rank
Node.js for APIs, automation scripts and static site builds
Static HTML builds for very fast, low-cost pages

cards.title: Databases
items: MySQL for WordPress and structured business data
MongoDB for flexible app data, logs and content stores
Backups and staging copies before every major change

cards.title: Integrations and tools
items: GitHub for version control, reviews and deploy history
Google Search Console, GA4 and Tag Manager on every site
Schema markup, XML sitemaps and Core Web Vitals checks
WhatsApp Business API, forms and CRM hand-offs

stack.intro_html: We pick the stack that fits the job. For example, a content-heavy blog needs a fast, easy editor, while a booking site needs custom logic and a database. Our website design and development team then hands each site to our SEO services team, and our backlink building work helps it earn authority. Here is what we use and why.

featured.intro: Real client websites, with their measured Google PageSpeed scores and Moz Page Authority.

network.h2: 138 websites we built on WordPress and more, each mapped to a target keyword
network.intro: 136 of these websites run on WordPress, and two client sites use a custom PHP build and React. Each one has its own focus, audience and primary keyword. Every card links to the site through its target keyword, so you can see the topic it is built to rank for.
network.note: Use the search box to find a site by keyword, industry or audience.

cta.h2: 150+ websites built on WordPress, Node.js and Next.js
cta.text: See our three featured client builds and 138 websites we built on WordPress and more, each mapped to a target keyword and built to rank.
cta.label: See our success stories

closing.h2: Want a website that ranks like these?
closing.text: Tell us about your business and target keywords. We will suggest the right stack and a build plan.
closing.label: Talk to our team
